raw-extract-sheet-1-report1674642037414..contentsIndicative: mechanical extract of the single sheet; header Value,Status,Product,Call Sign MMSI: Last Modified Date then 152,084 rows. Status vocabulary Allocated (100,351), Reserved (51,301), Available (422) and blank (10). Product vocabulary: Amateur Full (58,725), blank (44,712), Amateur Foundation (33,190), Amateur Intermediate (13,551), Amateur Club (1,829), Amateur Temporary Reciprocal (75), Special Event Station (2). Last-modified dates typed at source and rendered ISO, spanning 2016-07-23..2023-01-25. Anomalies preserved verbatim: two rows carry a blank Value (empty callsign); one Value is literally ',,'; fifteen Value cells were mangled into dates by Excel and are rendered ISO (e.g. 2023-11-20, 2023-03-20, 2023-05-20 - all Intermediate 20… callsigns); the trailing-NBSP trio (G0TQK, G7IWE, 2E1HON); 'G6 FMU' interior space; lower-case g0jrk and 2e1GTD; reciprocal 'M/…' forms including M/#PT2FM.

normalised--sheet-1-report1674642037414..contentsIndicative: header callsign,status,licence_class,last_modified_date; 152,084 rows sorted by callsign (source order carries no meaning). Status and licence_class (from Product) carried verbatim - 44,712 blank licence_class values (the reserved pool) and 10 blank statuses preserved. last_modified_date carried verbatim from the ISO-rendered workbook extract. Type is absent from this source (the only four-column snapshot). The trailing-NBSP trio is trimmed (the sole canonicalisation, counted at convert time). Two blank-callsign rows sort first, then the ',,' Value; the fifteen Excel-date-mangled callsigns (e.g. 2023-11-20) are carried verbatim, never reconstructed.
